unit.why: A single narrative about R. Moshe Leib of Sasov. He rejoices at a poor couple's wedding and wishes to be escorted to his grave with its tune, and at his death the musicians' horses miraculously bring them to his funeral.
unit.boundary_note: Numbered (מו); ends with a source note '(מובא בשהגה"ח...)'. OCR artifacts 'חתונהחתיכה' and 'פתאוםבתאום' appear in the text.

stories.start_quote: פעם אחת עשה נשואין לחתן וכלה עניים
stories.summary_en: The tsaddik arranged and joyfully celebrated a poor couple's wedding with musicians and wished that tune would accompany him to his grave. Years later, on the day of his death, the musicians' horses ran uncontrollably to the cemetery, where the people recalled his words and had the musicians play that tune.
